output.summary: A cultivated deciduous hybrid shrub, absent from the wild and probably originating in the foothills of central Asia or Iran. Its fragrant pink to light-red flowers are harvested for rose oil and rose water; the edible petals flavor foods, garnish dishes, make tea and are preserved in sugar.
output.edibilityNote: Petals are used as flavoring, garnish and herbal tea, or preserved in sugar; rose water and powdered roses also feature in cooking.
